subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Mail Theft and Redirection
description: A quick, practical guide to Mail Theft and Redirection.

hook.text: A thief files a change-of-address form at the post office. Your mail now goes to them.

buildup.text: They receive your bank statements, tax forms, and new credit cards before you notice.

discovery.text: Mail redirection forms require minimal verification. A forged signature is often enough.

twist.text: Victims don't realize their mail is missing because they assume bills are just late.

climax.text: By the time you notice the silence in your mailbox, the thief has had weeks of access.

punchline.text: An empty mailbox is a warning, not a relief.

quiz.question: How do identity thieves exploit mail redirection?
options: They file change-of-address forms with minimal verification
